children: Retail investors in Blackstone's flagship private-credit fund continue to head for the exits.

Blackstone Private Credit Fund, the largest private-credit fund pitched at individual investors, received redemption requests totaling $4.3 billion in its latest quarter, accounting for about 10% of shares outstanding.
The fund limited the payouts to 5% of its value, capping the payouts at the level these so-called semi-liquid funds are required to redeem.
It experienced another quarter of net outflows, losing about 3% of its net asset value.

This marks the third consecutive quarter that redemption requests at the fund, known as Bcred, surpassed the 5% level and the second straight quarter in which the fund has capped redemptions. In March, the fund paid out all the requests, exceeding the 5% level.

Since then, it and its peers have continued to see elevated redemptions. Also on Thursday, Cliffwater said its biggest private-credit fund received redemption requests totaling about 16% of outstanding shares and will repurchase 5%.
